title: Receipt, clarification and refusal remain distinct
goal: A requested breakfast has received/clarification/refused history without a promise, and a declined cancellation leaves the original arrival commitment active.
representative_failure: Withdrawing A and submitting identical B inside one fixed window makes replies ambiguous, so B cannot acquire A's provider decision.
scope: App-only business calls and static events. Core receipt/epoch/policy claims require the separate real MCP report.
